title: EquWord: Equation Conversion and Formatting for Microsoft Word

verified_template.candidate_label: 1.0.0 version update built in native Word
verified_template.meaning: Candidate byte identity; native verification status is recorded separately.

manifest_update_policy: Deliberately update accepted file hashes and actual native evidence. Draft packaging does not establish native compatibility. Both platform PASS results for this exact hash/version and final author approval are required before publication.

mac.scope: Supplied selection and whole-body LaTeX conversion fixtures, native fractions/Greek symbols/inner brackets, eligible multiline merge, saved mathematical/field/bookmark preservation, save/reopen formatting, reload and About after Word restart.

windows.scope: Supplied conversion, native format and selective-reformat fixtures; saved native equation edit, document-specific settings, preservation, save/reopen and repeat formatting after test Word-process restart.

limits: Exact binary, supplied fixtures and recorded installations only.
Every Word build, manuscript, notation/geometry option and Mac command was not exhaustively tested.
Large-document performance and forced over-height/page-boundary stress cases remain unverified.

evidence: Actual Word for Windows recheck 2026-10-28: seven processing runs and two About executions across two fresh Word processes.
58 saved-file/XML preservation support checks; 37 frozen source and installed-template files unchanged.
